sentences.text: Pantosaurus possessed between 35 and 40 cervical vertebrae, yet no skull or cranial material of this animal has been discovered yet.
A partially digested embryonic ichthyosaur found inside a Pantosaurus fossil provided the first evidence that plesiosaurs consumed ichthyosaurs.
The genus Pantosaurus was named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1893.

The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — is a partial articulated skeleton containing a distal humerus, four carpals, a coracoid fragment, and several cervical vertebrae from the Upper Member of the Sundance Formation.
Muraenosaurus reedii is considered a junior synonym of Pantosaurus, and the animal belongs to the family Cryptoclididae.
Pantosaurus lived in the Sundance Sea, an ancient sea that once covered Wyoming, between 161.5 and 154.8 million years ago during the Oxfordian stage.
